Ashe

the Frost Archer

Ashe is a simple, reliable marksman whose every attack slows. She's one of the best champions for learning the bot lane: no dashes to master, long range, and a global stun arrow that starts fights for your whole team.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Ashe

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. Her slows and long-range arrow are useful into any team, so she's a safe early pick.

Pick into

  • Teams that need setting up: her arrow starts fights from far away
  • Divers and melee champions she can kite with slows, like Draven or Lucian
  • Poke-light teams that let her farm safely
  • Low-range marksmen, like Ezreal, whom she out-damages

Avoid into

  • Hyper-scaling marksmen who out-damage her late, like Twitch and Kog'Maw
  • Assassins who reach her when her arrow is down
  • All-in lanes with hard engage that catch her without a dash

Great teammates

SeraphineSeraphine's poke and crowd control pair well with Ashe's slows.
MilioMilio gives her range and peel.
SennaSenna adds long-range damage and sustain.

Your team needs: Pick Ashe when your team needs engage or a way to start fights from range.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Every basic attack slows, so enemies struggle to escape or chase her
  • Enchanted Crystal Arrow is a long-range stun that can start a fight or save a teammate anywhere on the map
  • Hawkshot gives free vision of brushes, objectives and the enemy jungle
  • Easy to learn: most of her damage comes from attacking, not from hard combos

Weaknesses

  • No dash or blink, so she relies on Flash and positioning to survive
  • Easy target for divers and assassins once her arrow is used
  • Lower burst than other marksmen; she wins by steady damage, not big spikes
  • Struggles against hyper-scaling marksmen if the game goes very long

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Volley plus Ranger's Focus wins short trades against most marksmen
  • Level 6: Enchanted Crystal Arrow turns any skill shot from your support into a kill
  • First item (Hexoptics C44): extra range damage and crits make your trades far stronger
  • Two items (Phantom Dancer): your attack speed and slows make you very hard to escape
  • Three items (Infinity Edge): you become a real teamfight carry

Top tips

  • Hold four Focus stacks before trades so Ranger's Focus is ready the moment your support engages
  • Fire your arrow from far away: it stuns longer the farther it travels
  • Use Hawkshot on the enemy jungle at the start of the game to see where their jungler began
  • Volley can hit enemies hiding in brush and shows you if someone's there
  • Communicate before arrowing: ping the target so your team is ready to follow
  • Slows stack well with your support's crowd control: auto the target your support catches
